author: Pierluigi Paganini

title: Machine learning–powered Android Trojans bypass script-based Ad Click detection

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Arctic Wolf warned of a new wave of automated attacks making unauthorized firewall configuration changes on Fortinet FortiGate devices.
